ledger.label: Ledger
ledger.description: Precision and density for ops-heavy businesses — wholesale, distribution, accounting. A light, navy-tinted canvas built for tables.

hearth.label: Hearth
hearth.description: Warmth and clarity for client-facing service businesses — salons, retail, service companies. A sage-tinted canvas built for a handful of large things.

blueprint.label: Blueprint
blueprint.description: A drafted, technical register for contractors and field-service SMEs — site management, scheduling, materials. A cooler, higher-contrast canvas.

bare.label: Bare
bare.description: Nothing is boxed. No card borders, no shadows — sections are separated by space and a single rule, with larger type and roomier lines. For work with less on screen and more to read.

docket.label: Docket
docket.description: A pad of carbon-copy forms. Square corners throughout, ruled in ink rather than hairlines, column headings stamped in uppercase, and no shadow anywhere. For a business that writes dockets and receipts all day.

contract.heading: Why these aren't just three color swaps
contract.intro: Every page built with this design system, in any of the five styles, follows the same generation contract.
pageRules: The page states its answer. The one question the page exists to answer is the largest thing on it.
States are designed, not defaulted. Before data exists, the entry form is the page. After it exists, the input collapses to a summary with a Change affordance.
Explanation sits beside the thing it explains, never a permanent banner above everything.
Actions are named for what they do, and the label matches the heading above it.
Detail folds away. Supporting evidence opens automatically only when the verdict says something is wrong.
layoutRules: Full width, left-aligned, like every other page — a centred narrow column just leaves a dead right-hand gutter.
Rows of cards don't stretch. Where two cards of different natural heights sit side by side, the shorter one doesn't grow to match.
contract.componentRulesHeading: Component rules, in all five styles
componentRules: Weight ceiling: nothing exceeds semibold. No 700/800/900 weights, anywhere.
Tracking scales negatively with size — a large heading needs tighter tracking than body text.
Every control has a real associated label — never a placeholder standing in for one.
Numeric columns get tabular figures. Never running prose.
Status is never colour alone — every status colour is paired with a text label.
Disabled means a real disabled attribute, not faded opacity on a non-interactive element.

faq.title: What you are probably wondering.
faq.q1: How is this different from hiring a web shop?
faq.q1a: They start by guessing from what you described, then rebuild when it is wrong. Here you design the system first and we build that. Changing a design is free; changing code is not.
faq.q2: I am not good with computers. Can I do this?
faq.q2a: The system drafts itself from your trade first, so you are editing words, not drawing screens. If you would rather not touch it at all, type one sentence and it edits itself.
faq.q3a: The design appears in minutes. The build depends on scope — usually 3 to 6 weeks.
faq.q4: Is the data mine? Can I get locked in?
faq.q4a: It is yours, exportable in full at any time. If you want to buy the system outright and host it yourself, that is a conversation we will have.
faq.q5: Can I look before I commit?
faq.q5a: Yes. The design step costs nothing and asks for no card. If it is not for you, walk away.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: In short: we collect information about your business in order to design your system. We do not sell it, we do not advertise with it, and you can download all of it or delete all of it at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
From the questionnaire: your trade, how you work today, where things get stuck.
At signup: your email and password (the password is hashed — we cannot read it).
While you use it: what you call your business, the pages you design, the style you pick.
If you use Google: the email and name Google gives us.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body:
To analyse your business with AI and generate a first version of your system.
To let you sign in, save, and come back to it.
To build the real system from your design when you ask us to.
Those three things. Nothing else.

sections.heading: Where it lives
sections.body:
In Supabase (Postgres), on servers in Singapore (ap-southeast-1).
The site runs on Vercel.
What you type into the AI assistant is sent to OpenAI to process, and is not used for training.
No fourth party.

sections.heading: Who can see it
sections.body:
You.
And Formae's founder — he has to see what you designed in order to build it. That is the service.
No other customer can see yours. That is enforced in the database itself (Row Level Security), not by application code remembering to check.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body:
As long as your account exists.
Delete your account and your account, system, pages and history are permanently deleted.
The questionnaire record is kept (it no longer carries your identity once the account is gone) because it is our own business record.

sections.heading: What you can do
sections.body:
Download everything any time (My account → Export my data, JSON, free).
Delete your account any time (My account → Delete account).
Change your email or password on the same page.
Ask us anything on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: What each of us is responsible for. Designing is free and you can change it as often as you like; you pay when you decide to have it built.

sections.heading: What this service is
sections.body:
You use Formae to design the business system you want — which pages, what goes on each, what the columns are called, how the workflow runs.
Then our team builds a real, working system from that design.
Formae itself is not that system. It is where you design and approve it.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.body:
Designing: free. Change it as often as you like.
Build fee: RM5,000 (if your needs are unusually large we will tell you and quote before starting).
Hosting: RM100–300 per month depending on usage.
Payment is by bank transfer; we enable saving on your account once it arrives. There is no online payment yet.

sections.heading: Your work is yours
sections.body:
The system you design and the data you put in it are yours.
You can export all of it at any time, free.
If you later want to own the whole system outright (code and database), that is a separate conversation and a separate fee.

sections.heading: What we are responsible for
sections.body:
We will build what you approved.
We do not promise the system will make you more money — that depends on how you use it.
While you are hosted with us, we keep it running. Stop hosting and it stops.
If we lose your data through our own fault, we restore it. What you delete yourself, we cannot.

sections.heading: When we would close an account
sections.body:
Using it for something illegal.
Using it to attack this system or anyone else's.
Hosting unpaid for a long time.
Otherwise we will not close your account. If we ever have to, we tell you first and give you time to export.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body:
If these terms change we will tell you at your next sign-in.
Price increases are not retroactive — a price already agreed is the price.

showroom.body: Five pages, four tables, seventeen fields — in your trade’s own words, with your workflow, and every part of it editable. Not a screenshot: the actual thing you get.
